name: bg-cut
desc: Free, open-source background remover for Windows — local ONNX models, alpha matting refine, batch cutouts. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **One-click cutout** — subject separated from background in a second with local ONNX inference
✅ **Edge refine pass** — alpha matting slider keeps hair and fur edges clean instead of a scissor outline
✅ **Batch folder mode** — hundreds of product shots cut out unattended into transparent PNGs
✅ **Mask export** — the alpha mask saved separately for compositing workflows
✅ **Auto-trim** — transparent margins cropped to the subject for tidy exports
✅ **Format control** — PNG, WebP and JPG-with-white options per batch
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Price | **Free, MIT** | Paid credits | Free, OSS | Paid subscription |
| Photos stay local | **Yes** | Upload | Yes | Yes
| Alpha matting refine | **Yes** | No | Flag only | Manual
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Browser | Python env | Installer
faqQ: free background remover for Windows without uploading photos?
faqA: Free web removers downscale results, cap downloads and keep your photos. bg-cut runs cutout models locally with an alpha matting refine pass and batch mode for whole folders. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, unlimited and offline once the model is on disk.
s1: Dark editor (#121418, violet #A78BFA): before and after panes with checkerboard behind the cut subject, refine slider at 0.6, edge zoom inset in the corner.
s2: Batch panel: folder with 340 images queued, thumbnail strip showing completed cutouts, progress reading 87 percent, format dropdown set to PNG.
s3: Export options: mask export toggle on, trim transparent toggle on, size estimate chip, toast reading 340 cutouts written to folder.
